g.title: Actual sampled specimen-surface arrivals. Bars show sampled support, not a PSF or dose.

text.tspan: Central π step: about 50% of depletion pupil area.
Both beams: circular polarization; 4 kHz / 3% gates.
Geometric model: phase and arrivals only.
No depletion field, vectorial PSF, voxel size or curing.
Design choices: geometry, timing and power; see note.
